parameters.name: num_product_types
parameters.description: Number of product types indexed by p = 0,...,P-1

parameters.name: unit_selling_price
parameters.description: Unit selling price of product type p

parameters.name: unit_manufacturing_cost
parameters.description: Unit manufacturing cost of product type p

parameters.name: unit_warehouse_space_requirement
parameters.description: Unit warehouse-space requirement of product type p

parameters.name: minimum_required_production
parameters.description: Minimum required production quantity for product type p, with 0 if not applicable

parameters.name: production_limit
parameters.description: Maximum total number of units that may be produced

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Integer number of units of product type p to produce

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit of the production plan

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_production_quantity
constraints.description: Production quantities must be feasible integer unit counts for each product type

constraints.name: warehouse_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Total warehouse space used by all produced items cannot exceed the available warehouse capacity

constraints.name: production_limit
constraints.description: The total number of units produced across all product types cannot exceed the overall production limit

constraints.name: minimum_production_requirement
constraints.description: For each product type, production must meet or exceed the specified minimum required level

constraints.name: profit_definition
constraints.description: The total profit variable equals the sum of per-unit margins times production quantities

objectives.name: profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit of the production plan

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit, defined as the sum over all product types of unit profit \((s_p-c_p)\) times produced quantity \(x_p\).
